name: mnemon
description: LLM-supervised persistent memory for AI agents — graph-based recall, cross-session knowledge, single binary. Works with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any agent runtime.

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: fig → Mnemon to pick a storage scope, and use the Memory System tab in a session to create or activate memory spaces.
capability_evidence.api-gateway: ts** — export hashed operation receipts for memory-boundary audits without raw memory contents or queries
capability_evidence.skills-plugins: e extensions; MiniMax Code and Nanobot integrate via skill files; NanoClaw integrates
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode

friction.note_en: Involved setup. install via Homebrew install, go install; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure environment variables, config.json/yaml/toml
friction.note_zh: 配置较重。可通过 Homebrew install、go install 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 environment variables、config.json/yaml/toml

analysis.summary_en: LLM agents forget everything between sessions.
highlights: Runtime-native integration — runtime-specific SKILL.md, shared guide.md, and supported hooks or extensions
Built-in deduplication — remember and import skip exact content repeats and preserve distinct facts; similarity suggestions guide review
Retention lifecycle — importance decay, access-count boosting, and garbage collection
LLM-supervised — the host LLM decides what to remember, update, and forget; no embedded LLM, no API keys
